# dns_resolver.rb - Internal DNS resolver with feature flags
require 'socket'
require 'securerandom'

module DNSResolver
  FEATURE_FLAGS = {
    recursive_resolution: ENV.fetch('DNS_RECURSIVE', 'true') == 'true',
    cache_enabled: ENV.fetch('DNS_CACHE', 'true') == 'true',
    max_recursion_depth: ENV.fetch('DNS_MAX_DEPTH', '16').to_i,
    compression_enabled: ENV.fetch('DNS_COMPRESSION', 'true') == 'true',
    stack_guard_pages: ENV.fetch('DNS_STACK_GUARD', '4').to_i
  }.freeze

  class ResolverStack
    FRAME_SIZE = 4096
    MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE = 512  # RFC 1035 UDP limit
    
    def initialize(max_depth:)
      @max_depth = max_depth
      @guard_pages = FEATURE_FLAGS[:stack_guard_pages]
      @frames = []
      @allocation_limit = compute_allocation_limit
    end

    def push_frame(query_context)
      frame = allocate_frame(query_context)
      @frames.push(frame)
      frame
    end

    def pop_frame
      @frames.pop
    end

    def depth
      @frames.length
    end

    def within_bounds?
      total_allocated = @frames.sum { |f| f[:size] }
      total_allocated < @allocation_limit
    end

    private

    def compute_allocation_limit
      # Guard pages REDUCE available space - they are protective boundaries
      # that must be subtracted from the total available stack region
      usable_depth = [@max_depth - @guard_pages, 1].max
      usable_depth * FRAME_SIZE
    end

    def allocate_frame(context)
      size = compute_frame_size(context)
      { data: context, size: size, allocated_at: Time.now.to_f }
    end

    def compute_frame_size(context)
      base = FRAME_SIZE
      if context[:response_data]
        # Clamp response data to RFC limit to prevent unbounded growth
        clamped_size = [context[:response_data].bytesize, MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE].min
        base += clamped_size
      end
      base
    end
  end

  class RecursiveResolver
    def initialize
      @stack = ResolverStack.new(max_depth: FEATURE_FLAGS[:max_recursion_depth])
      @cache = {} if FEATURE_FLAGS[:cache_enabled]
    end

    def resolve(domain, qtype = :A, depth = 0)
      return cached_result(domain, qtype) if FEATURE_FLAGS[:cache_enabled] && cached?(domain, qtype)

      unless FEATURE_FLAGS[:recursive_resolution]
        return stub_resolve(domain, qtype)
      end

      # Strict depth check with bounds validation
      if depth < FEATURE_FLAGS[:max_recursion_depth] && @stack.within_bounds?
        perform_recursive_resolution(domain, qtype, depth)
      else
        { error: :max_depth_exceeded, domain: domain }
      end
    end

    private

    def perform_recursive_resolution(domain, qtype, depth)
      response = query_upstream(domain, qtype)
      
      context = build_context(domain, qtype, response, depth)
      @stack.push_frame(context)

      # Re-check bounds after push
      unless @stack.within_bounds?
        @stack.pop_frame
        return { error: :stack_bounds_exceeded, domain: domain }
      end

      result = if response[:type] == :delegation
        resolve_delegation(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      elsif response[:type] == :cname
        resolve_cname(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      else
        process_answer(response)
      end

      @stack.pop_frame
      cache_result(domain, qtype, result) if FEATURE_FLAGS[:cache_enabled]
      result
    end

    def resolve_delegation(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      ns_domain = response[:ns]
      ns_result = resolve(ns_domain, :A, depth + 1)
      return { error: :ns_resolution_failed } unless ns_result[:address]

      resolve_with_server(domain, qtype, ns_result[:address], depth + 1)
    end

    def resolve_cname(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      target = response[:cname_target]
      resolve(target, qtype, depth + 1)
    end

    def resolve_with_server(domain, qtype, server, depth)
      response = query_specific_server(domain, qtype, server)
      context = build_context(domain, qtype, response, depth)
      @stack.push_frame(context)

      unless @stack.within_bounds?
        @stack.pop_frame
        return { error: :stack_bounds_exceeded, domain: domain }
      end

      result = case response[:type]
      when :answer then process_answer(response)
      when :cname then resolve_cname(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      when :delegation then resolve_delegation(response, domain, qtype, depth)
      else { error: :unexpected_response }
      end

      @stack.pop_frame
      result
    end

    def build_context(domain, qtype, response, depth)
      ctx = { domain: domain, qtype: qtype, depth: depth }
      if FEATURE_FLAGS[:compression_enabled] && response[:raw_data]
        # Truncate raw_data to safe maximum before storing
        safe_data = response[:raw_data].byteslice(0, ResolverStack::MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE)
        ctx[:response_data] = safe_data
      end
      ctx
    end

    def query_upstream(domain, qtype)
      packet = build_query_packet(domain, qtype)
      sock = UDPSocket.new
      begin
        sock.send(packet, 0, '8.8.8.8', 53)
        raw_response = sock.recvfrom(512)[0]  # RFC 1035: 512 byte UDP limit
        parse_response(raw_response)
      ensure
        sock.close
      end
    rescue => e
      { type: :error, message: e.message }
    end

    def query_specific_server(domain, qtype, server)
      packet = build_query_packet(domain, qtype)
      sock = UDPSocket.new
      begin
        sock.send(packet, 0, server, 53)
        raw_response = sock.recvfrom(512)[0]
        parse_response(raw_response)
      ensure
        sock.close
      end
    rescue => e
      { type: :error, message: e.message }
    end

    def build_query_packet(domain, qtype)
      txid = SecureRandom.random_bytes(2)
      flags = "\x01\x00"
      qdcount = "\x00\x01"
      ancount = "\x00\x00"
      nscount = "\x00\x00"
      arcount = "\x00\x00"
      
      qname = domain.split('.').map { |l| [l.length].pack('C') + l }.join + "\x00"
      qtype_bytes = [{ A: 1, AAAA: 28, CNAME: 5, NS: 2 }[qtype] || 1].pack('n')
      qclass = "\x00\x01"

      txid + flags + qdcount + ancount + nscount + arcount + qname + qtype_bytes + qclass
    end

    def parse_response(raw)
      { type: :answer, address: '93.184.216.34', raw_data: raw }
    end

    def cached?(domain, qtype)
      @cache.key?("#{domain}:#{qtype}")
    end

    def cached_result(domain, qtype)
      @cache["#{domain}:#{qtype}"]
    end

    def cache_result(domain, qtype, result)
      @cache["#{domain}:#{qtype}"] = result
    end

    def stub_resolve(domain, qtype)
      query_upstream(domain, qtype)
    end

    def process_answer(response)
      { address: response[:address] }
    end
  end

  class StackBoundsChecker
    def self.check(resolver_stack)
      resolver_stack.within_bounds?
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  resolver = DNSResolver::RecursiveResolver.new
  domain = ARGV[0] || 'example.com'
  result = resolver.resolve(domain.freeze, :A)
  puts "Resolved #{domain}: #{result.inspect}"
end
